source.description:
## PROBLEM
PR #278 CI run 33697188109 failed once in tests/unit/cli/stop.test.ts:170 because stdoutWrites was empty instead of containing `Reaped orphaned PID 1234`. The exact branch then passed 20/20 isolated local repetitions, a complete local full suite, and the CI failed-job rerun (job 100469195897) without source changes. This indicates shared process/module/mock timing or isolation flakiness in the terminal-alive orphan-reaper test.

## SUCCESS
Root-cause the nondeterminism and make the terminal-alive stop test deterministic under full-suite CI concurrency without weakening process-reaping assertions.

## SCOPE
tests/unit/cli/stop.test.ts and only the minimum test/runtime seam needed after root-cause proof.

## VALIDATION
Reproduce or instrument the original failure; run repeated isolated and full-suite stress; preserve assertions for stdout, group SIGTERM, and stop_terminal_alive_reaped observability.
source.title: stabilize stop CLI terminal-alive orphan reaper test
